importIntro: TopstepX has a built-in CSV export, which makes it one of the easiest platforms to journal from:
importSteps: Log into TopstepX at topstepx.com/trade.
Open the Trades tab at the bottom of the platform (use Trades rather than Orders for your fill history).
Click Export at the bottom-right of that panel.
Pick your date range and click Export again — the CSV downloads straight from the platform.
In FreeTradeJournal, open Trades and use Import CSV. The column-mapping step lets you match TopstepX's columns in a few clicks.
Re-export with a fresh date range whenever you want to top the journal up; duplicate trades are flagged on import.

faqs.question: Does FreeTradeJournal work with Topstep accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes. TopstepX exports your trade history as CSV from the Trades tab, and FreeTradeJournal imports it directly. The dashboard then shows your P&L, win rate, and daily results, and the prop firm dashboard tracks your progress and drawdown.

faqs.question: How do I export my trades from TopstepX?
faqs.answer: In TopstepX, open the Trades tab at the bottom, click Export at the bottom-right, choose your date range, and confirm. The CSV downloads immediately. Then use Import CSV on the Trades page in FreeTradeJournal.

faqs.question: How does Topstep's Maximum Loss Limit work?
faqs.answer: It starts $2,000 to $4,500 below your starting balance depending on account size, and trails your end-of-day balance upward. It is enforced in real time, including unrealized P&L, and it stops trailing once it reaches your starting balance, where it locks permanently.

faqs.question: What is the Topstep consistency rule?
faqs.answer: Your best single day must stay below 50% of the profit target. If one day is carrying more than half your progress, you need more profitable days before the Combine can be passed.

faqs.question: Can I still use NinjaTrader or Tradovate with Topstep?
faqs.answer: No. New Combines have been TopstepX-only since July 2025, and resets since August 2025. Quantower can still connect for the Combine and Express Funded stages. If you trade Tradovate elsewhere, FreeTradeJournal imports Tradovate CSVs too.

faqs.question: Is FreeTradeJournal really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Unlimited trade logging, CSV import and export, dashboard analytics, goals, and 20 AI analyses a month cost nothing and need no card. Pro is $12.99/month or $99.99/year and removes the free plan's limits.
